name: blobs-sqlite
title: blobs-sqlite
description: Copied SQLite blob store component. You own its files.

files.content:
update blob_slot
set hash = :hash, size = :size, name = :name, filled_at = :filled_at
where id = :id and hash is null and expires_at > :now
returning id

insert into blob (hash, size, created_at)
values (:hash, :size, :created_at)
on conflict do nothing

insert into blob_slot (id, owner, max_bytes, expires_at)
values (:id, :owner, :max_bytes, :expires_at)

select size
from blob
where hash = :hash

select owner, max_bytes, expires_at, name, hash, size
from blob_slot
where id = :id

-- The blob store's two tables. A blob row is written only after its file is in place.
create table blob (
  hash text primary key,
  size integer not null,
  created_at integer not null
);

create table blob_slot (
  id text primary key,
  owner text not null,
  max_bytes integer not null,
  expires_at integer not null,
  name text,
  hash text,
  size integer,
  filled_at integer
);
